user.title: Sign in to E-Distribuzione
user.description: Browser sign-in is recommended: it passes the anti-bot protection without giving the password to Home Assistant. Password + OTP remains available as an alternative.

password_login.title: Sign in with password and OTP
password_login.description: Use the same credentials as the official E-Distribuzione app or website. You will then be asked for the OTP sent by this configuration.{pod_correnti}

antibot.title: Automated access was blocked
antibot.description: E-Distribuzione blocked the login performed directly by Home Assistant. Continue in a normal browser so the anti-bot protection can verify that session.

browser_login.title: Authorize E-Distribuzione in your browser
browser_login.description: First sign in to the [E-Distribuzione customer portal](https://private.e-distribuzione.it/PortaleClienti/s/) in the same browser. Then open [the official authorization]({authorization_url}). A blank final page is expected. Open Chrome DevTools Console (`⌥⌘J` on macOS), find the “Failed to launch `eneldist://redirect?...`” error, right-click its `eneldist://...` link, choose “Copy link address”, paste it below, and submit. Authentication then completes directly, without a second XML exchange. Home Assistant does not store the password.{pod_correnti}

browser_token_exchange.title: Complete the OAuth exchange in your browser
browser_token_exchange.description: Open [the local token exchange page]({exchange_url}). The browser will submit the OAuth form to E-Distribuzione and show an XML page. Select and copy the whole page, then paste it below. Do not share this private token response.

data.oauth_response: OAuth XML response returned by the browser

error.invalid_browser_redirect: The final URL is invalid, incomplete, or belongs to another attempt.
error.invalid_browser_token: The OAuth response is invalid or does not contain the required tokens.

abort.browser_exchange_missing: The OAuth exchange session is no longer available. Restart reauthentication.

antibot_refresh_blocked.title: Access to E-Distribuzione is temporarily blocked
antibot_refresh_blocked.description:
E-Distribuzione's anti-bot protection is preventing automatic access renewal for **{entry_title}**. Data will not be updated until the block ends.

This does not necessarily mean that the password is wrong. Avoid repeated attempts, sign out of the official E-Distribuzione app and website, wait a few hours, and retry without a VPN or proxy. This issue will disappear automatically when renewal works again.

init.title: Reauthenticate E-Distribuzione
init.description: Start a new authentication for **{entry_title}**. If the anti-bot page appears again, stop trying and retry after a few hours. Select **Submit** to continue.
